files.CHANGES.md: what changed since the previous version and what needs review
files.table.csv: the table rebuilt from the checks (rating, restrictions, countries, statuses, comparison with the site)
files.report.md: the same per interface with every check, its source and the matched text
files.results/: raw results of check_code / check_bundle / check_docs / check_api / check_live
files.evidence/: what each check saw: code lines, page text, API responses, proxy vantage
files.checks/: the check definitions used for this version (copy of research/checks/)
files.catalog/: monitor/data/interfaces.json and observations.json, monitor/out/report.md and interfaces.csv of this version
